controls.name: Order service type

controls.name: Delivery information

controls.name: Package Details and Additional Information

controls.name: Documents to sign by Recipient

controls.notes: The section was explicitly labeled optional. Each document type also had an adjacent unlabeled action button.

controls.name: Quick Import CSV
controls.purpose: Import order/address data from a CSV or XLSX file using documented column mappings.

result.summary: ADM New order is a client- and facility-contextual order-entry page at /orders/new. It captures recipient and prescription information, delivery and signature choices, package details, optional documents, and supports CSV/XLSX import. Recent orders are shown alongside the form. The module was fully reached and safely observed without submitting, resetting, uploading, accepting terms, or changing business data.
